title: Every published Space website gets a free <slug> subdomain address with no setup

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-06: "I like the free address thing but let's bring that in as a feature later"; design note /mnt/project-files/white-label/2026-10-06-domain-design.md (Optional: a free address for every Space); white label sites build ADR-1708

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 by owner ruling, as a later feature. THE CONSEQUENCE: a published Space website's only no-setup address is <app>/sites/<slug>, which reads as a Frequency page, not the Space's own site. THE FIX: serve <slug>.<a Frequency domain> as the Space's website. Needs a Frequency domain whose nameservers are on Vercel plus one wildcard domain on the project (owner steps), then lib/sites/host.ts treats a one-label subdomain of that domain as a site host and rewrites it to the site route by slug (today every subdomain of APP_APEXES is the app). Reserved labels (www, app, api, admin and the like) stay the app. LIFT: S, about 4 files, no migration. Probe flips when host.ts exports the subdomain resolver.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/host.ts','utf8');if(!/export function siteSlugFromSubdomain\b/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-782: no free <slug> subdomain resolver in lib/sites/host.ts yet');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails today: host.ts treats every subdomain of a Frequency apex as the app. Passes when siteSlugFromSubdomain exists and routes a Space slug subdomain to its website.
